parsed.seniority_signal: Several years of professional experience in Automotive Cybersecurity.
parsed.german_signal: Business-fluent German and English language skills.
parsed.degree_signal: University degree in Computer Science or a comparable IT-related field.
parsed.notes:
Only the qualifications under “What should you bring along?” supply candidate skill requirements; no optional section is present.
“Several years” is interpreted as mid-level experience, but does not specify an exact range.
AWS/Azure is interpreted as platform alternatives. Docker/Kubernetes names complementary containerization and orchestration technologies, not alternatives.
The combined CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code examples are grouped by their respective asks: Terraform/Ansible and GitHub Actions/GitLab CI. Longer quotes distinguish these required mentions from their responsibility-only occurrences.
Static and dynamic code analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing have no exact taxonomy entries; they are not broadened to generic software testing.
“Comparable IT-related field” widens the degree field, not the accepted qualification. Generic open-source technologies do not specifically ask for open-source LLMs.
